origin.description: Stores the training rows. The prediction is the nearest class.
origin.usage: gknn(x, y, k = 1, method = NULL, scale = TRUE, use_all = TRUE)

arguments.name: scale
arguments.text: Center and divide by the sample standard deviation.

origin.details: The check leaves scaling off. Distances come from proxy.
origin.value: One label code per new row.
origin.example: fit <- gknn(matrix(c(0,0, 3,0, 0,4, 6,6), ncol=2, byrow=TRUE), factor(c("a","b","a","b")), k=1, scale=FALSE); cat(as.integer(predict(fit, matrix(c(0.2,0.2, 2.8,0.2), ncol=2, byrow=TRUE))), "\n")
